name: fraith-system
description: D&D 5e Campaign Portal (3 Players + 1 DM) on Cloudflare Pages, Workers, D1, R2 & Durable Objects with Long Story Short integration

scripts.dev:pages: wrangler pages dev dist --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8788 --d1 DB --r2 BUCKET --do CAMPAIGN_DO=CampaignRoom@fraith-campaign-do
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name fraith-system
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:do && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy:pages
